scientific_question: Does autumn Love-Otto spatial cohesion/fragmentation contain incremental information about next-year Svalbard reindeer population growth beyond current abundance and contemporaneous spatial scale?
novelty_boundary: Wild temporal validation of a spatial-state indicator against later demography; not a claim that spatial early warning, animal-movement indicators, or ecological forecasting are unprecedented.

known_before_lock: Love & Otto (2026) metric definitions, simulations and case-study conclusions
Dryad metadata, file names, variable descriptions and aggregate statement that reindeer abundance increased substantially over the study period
GPS coverage summary: 2009-2023, 135 females, 419 animal-years, 319774 locations, 12-48 collared females per year
not_opened_before_lock_in_this_project: any fitted or descriptive association between Love-Otto metrics and annual population growth
exposure_firewall.implication: This is a locked retrospective temporal-validation contract, not outcome-blind preregistration.

movement_state.daily_snapshot: one position per individual nearest 12:00 UTC
movement_state.coordinates: published x/y UTM zone 33 coordinates as provided; no attempt to restore spatial precision removed by the archive
movement_state.deterministic_subsample_rule: sort IDs by SHA256(date|replicate_index|id) and take first 10
movement_state.scale_baseline: mean pairwise distance on the same fixed-n samples
movement_state.annual_aggregation: arithmetic mean across eligible daily fixed-n summaries

population_state.extraction_rule: For each calendar year in the workbook, require exactly one unique non-missing finite positive N.tot value after deduplication across plot rows; ambiguity is a STOP.

primary_models.estimator: ordinary least squares with intercept; no hyperparameter tuning
primary_models.standardization: predictors standardized from training transitions only within each rolling-origin fold
primary_models.validation: rolling-origin one-step-ahead over eligible adjacent-year transitions
primary_models.decision: detected_incremental_future_information only if M1 has lower RMSE and lower MAE than M0; otherwise no_detected_incremental_future_information

prespecified_sensitivities.metric_family: after the primary cvratio result, replace cvratio separately with cvpop and cvind; never select the best as replacement primary
prespecified_sensitivities.full_sample: repeat daily metrics using all eligible individuals instead of fixed n=10
prespecified_sensitivities.recent_growth: where N_(t-1) is available, add log(N_t/N_(t-1)) to both M0 and M1
prespecified_sensitivities.linear_time: add standardized calendar year to both M0 and M1 to test whether any CV gain is only a shared long-term trend

stop_rules: Do not change the Sep15-Nov15 window after row-level data access.
Do not lower the n=10 daily gate or the 30-day annual gate.
Do not increase the nearest-noon tolerance beyond 6 hours.
Do not restore or jitter spatial precision removed by the public archive.
Do not replace cvratio with cvpop/cvind based on performance.
Do not change the annual N.tot extraction rule after viewing values.
Do not tune a binary decline threshold.
Do not use non-adjacent years as if they were one-year transitions.
If fewer than 11 adjacent-year transitions survive all gates, report insufficient_temporal_replication and stop primary inference.

claim_ceiling.positive: Within one long-term wild reindeer population, the frozen autumn Love-Otto CV ratio improved rolling one-year-ahead prediction of population growth beyond current abundance and contemporaneous spatial scale.
claim_ceiling.null: No incremental future-population information was detected under the frozen metric, season, sampling, abundance extraction and rolling-validation design.
claim_ceiling.never: A universal cross-species early-warning law or a causal effect of spatial fragmentation on population growth.
